name: Armor of Magical Strength
description:
Prerequisite: A suit of armor (requires attunement)

This armor has 6 charges. The wearer can expend the armor's charges in the following ways: When the wearer makes a Strength check or a Strength saving throw, it can expend 1 charge to add a bonus to the roll equal to its Intelligence modifier. If the creature would be knocked prone, it can use its reaction to expend 1 charge to avoid being knocked prone. The armor regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn.
